descriptionChirho: To experience a dream, especially a prophetic or revelatory dream, used across all Qal finite verb forms (perfect, imperfect, consecutive imperfect) in various persons and numbers.
One who dreams, used as an agent noun or progressive participle denoting a person characterized by dreaming or in the act of dreaming.
To cause or induce dreaming in others, the causative stem indicating the subject brings about dreams rather than experiencing them directly.
A dream as a noun, referring to the visionary experience itself rather than the act of dreaming.
